question: Who Owns Benihana?
quick_answer: Benihana is owned by The ONE Group Hospitality, a US restaurant company that acquired Benihana's parent in 2024 for about $365 million. The ONE Group also runs STK Steakhouse and Kona Grill, which it already owned before the Benihana deal. Benihana was founded in 1964 in New York City by Japanese immigrant Rocky Aoki.

body.heading: Who owns Benihana?
body.text: Benihana is owned by The ONE Group Hospitality, a US restaurant company that trades publicly. The ONE Group acquired Benihana's parent company in 2024 in a deal worth about $365 million, which also brought RA Sushi into the group.

body.heading: Part of a bigger group
body.text: The ONE Group was not new to restaurants when it bought Benihana. It already owned and operated STK Steakhouse and Kona Grill before the 2024 deal, so Benihana joined an existing group of dining brands rather than being the company's only chain.

body.heading: The brand's roots
body.text: Benihana was founded in 1964 in New York City by Hiroaki 'Rocky' Aoki, a Japanese immigrant and former wrestler. He built it into a US chain famous for teppanyaki cooking at the table, and it later became part of The ONE Group.

faqs.a: The ONE Group Hospitality acquired Benihana's parent company in 2024 for about $365 million, in a deal that also included RA Sushi.

faqs.q: Does the same company own Kona Grill and Benihana?
faqs.a: Yes. The ONE Group Hospitality owns Benihana, and it already owned STK Steakhouse and Kona Grill before the 2024 Benihana deal.
Benihana was founded in 1964 in New York City by Hiroaki 'Rocky' Aoki, a Japanese immigrant.
